We Don’t Just Install Cabinets. We Show Up, Do It Right, And Leave Your Home Better Than We Found It.

Get a Free Estimate
FOUNDER
LIAM MCCORMACK

Our founder, Liam McCormack didn’t take the traditional path. He left college after a year — not because he couldn’t hack it, but because he looked around at where that path was leading and decided it wasn’t where he wanted to go.

What he did have was a lifetime of hands-on experience. Growing up in a family of entrepreneurs, Liam was fixing plumbing and hanging entry doors at age 12. Work ethics and problem-solving weren’t things he learned in a classroom. They were things he lived.

He found his way back to the trades, built relationships with clients and crews, and eventually built what is now 3 Day Cabinet Pros and More. He’ll tell you it’s been the most rewarding journey of his life — and that they’re just getting started.

71

Hundreds of families served
The Lesson That Shaped Everything

Early in his career, Liam learned a lesson the hard way — the kind of lesson that sticks.
His crew was already running slightly behind on a project. The plumber had to leave for his next job and couldn’t return until the following week. There was a sink to hook up. One of the cabinet crew had some basic plumbing experience. The temptation was obvious: just have him do it. Get it done. Stay on schedule.
He did. One trap wasn’t seated correctly. Water spilled across the floor.
The mess was caught quickly. The damage was minimal. But the lesson was permanent.

Slow down to do it right — even when it’s not easy. Especially when it’s not easy.

That single experience became the foundation of how 3 Day Cabinet Pros operates today. Cutting corners doesn’t save time. It doubles it. Taking the easy road serves no one — not the client, not the crew, not the company.

	
Slow down to do it right — even when it's not easy. Especially when it's not easy.
— Liam McCormack
AN HONEST WORD
What Drives Liam Crazy About This Industry.

Here’s something Liam will say out loud that most contractors won’t:

A long timeline is not a sign of quality. It’s a sign of a problem.

When a kitchen remodel drags on for six, seven, or nine weeks, it doesn’t mean the contractor is being meticulous. It means something broke down — the wrong people on the job, poor management, or expectations that were never set correctly before the first cabinet was touched.

Quality shouldn’t take forever. That’s not a tagline. It’s a standard.

Quality Shouldn’t Take Forever

HOW WE OPERATE.
01
The crew that installs your cabinets are our team members — not subcontractors.

Cabinet installation is the foundation of every kitchen project. 3 Day Cabinet Pros keeps that work entirely in-house, with a team that has been together for an average of five-plus years. That’s not an accident. That’s a culture.

02
For specialty trades, we only work with people we know.

Plumbing, electrical, countertops — these require licensed specialists. Every subcontractor 3 Day Cabinet Pros works with has been a trusted partner for at least two years. No strangers in your home.

03
When something goes wrong, we don’t hide it.

Things happen on job sites. When they do, Liam’s approach is simple: communicate the facts, skip the blame, and work out a plan with the client. Most problems on a job aren’t anyone’s fault. But they are always 3 Day Cabinet Pros’ responsibility — to fix it, facilitate it, or find someone who can.

WHAT LIAM WANTS YOU TO FEEL
When The Job is Done…

When the job is done, Liam wants one thing:

He wants you to feel like you could invite him over for dinner.

And if you do — he’ll probably say yes.

That’s the kind of contractor he is. That’s the kind of company 3 Day Cabinet Pros is. If that sounds like the person you want in your home, let’s talk.

The Problem We Solve 

A kitchen remodel is one of the biggest investments you’ll make in your home. It’s also one of the most stressful — because most contractors treat your house like a job site and your timeline like a suggestion.

You’ve heard the stories. Six weeks become ten. The crew shows up three days a week. Nobody answers the phone. You’re eating takeout for two months and still don’t have a kitchen.

That’s not how we work.

Why 3 Day Cabinet Pros Is Different

We set expectations before we touch a single cabinet.

Before any work begins, you’ll have a detailed scope, a clear budget breakdown, and a realistic timeline. No vague estimates. No surprise change orders. No “we’ll figure it out as we go.”


Our installation crew works for us — not a subcontractor list.

The people installing your cabinets are our full-time employees. They’ve been with us an average of five-plus years. They show up when they’re supposed to, they work clean, and they take pride in what they build. Because it has their name on it too.

Quality shouldn't take forever.

We Listen First

We start with a conversation about your vision, your budget, and your timeline. We’ll tell you honestly what’s achievable — and what isn’t. No pressure. No sales pitch.

We Build Your Plan

Our team develops a detailed design plan with layout options, material selections, and a transparent cost breakdown. You’ll know exactly what every dollar is doing before we schedule a start date.

03
We Get to Work

Our in-house crew manages every detail of the installation. We work efficiently, keep your home clean, and minimize disruption to your daily life. You’ll get regular updates so you always know where things stand.

04
We Walk Through It Together

When the job is done, we do a thorough walkthrough with you — not a handshake at the door. Every detail gets reviewed. Every question gets answered. We don’t consider the job finished until you do.

A Bathroom Remodel Should Feel Like an Upgrade. Not an Ordeal.

Your bathroom is the first room you walk into every morning and the last one you use every night. When it’s outdated, cramped, or just doesn’t work — you feel it every single day.

The problem isn’t deciding to remodel. The problem is finding someone you can trust to do it without turning your home upside down for months.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
THE PROBLEM WE SOLVE
BATHROOM REMODELS HAVE A REPUTATION — AND NOT A GOOD ONE.

Contractors who underestimate the job. Tile work that doesn’t line up. Fixtures ordered wrong. A shower out of commission for three weeks while someone “figures it out.” And through all of it, you’re sharing one bathroom with your entire family, waiting for a phone call that doesn’t come.

We’ve heard every version of this story from homeowners who came to us after someone else made a mess of it.

Here’s what we do differently.

WHY 3 DAY CABINET PROS IS DIFFERENT

We plan the whole job before we start any of it.

Every material, every fixture, every subcontractor is confirmed before we schedule your start date. We don’t begin a bathroom remodel hoping things will fall into place. We know they will — because we’ve already made sure of it.


Our in-house crew handles the core work.

The people doing your tile, your vanity installation, your finish work — they’re our employees. They’ve been with us an average of five-plus years. They’re not strangers pulled from a list. They’re craftsmen who do this every day and take the result personally.


Our specialty trade partners are people we actually know.

Plumbing and electrical require licensed specialists. Every subcontractor we bring into your home has worked alongside us for at least two years. We know how they work. We trust them in your space. That matters.

The Right Countertop Can Transform a Kitchen. The Wrong Installation Can Ruin It.

Countertops are the first thing people notice when they walk into your kitchen. They’re what your guests comment on. They’re what you touch a hundred times a day.

Getting them right isn’t just about choosing a beautiful material. It’s about precise measurement, expert fabrication, and an installation that fits perfectly — the first time.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
The Problem With Most Countertop Installations

Here’s where a lot of contractors cut corners:
Measurement is rushed. Templating is imprecise. The fabricator gets numbers that are close — but not exact. And when the countertop arrives, there’s a gap at the wall, a seam that doesn’t line up, or an edge profile that doesn’t match what you selected.

Fixing it means pulling the slab, going back to the fabricator, and waiting again. Meanwhile your kitchen is out of commission and your patience is gone.
Precision isn’t optional with countertops. It’s the whole job.

HOW WE HANDLE COUNTERTOPS DIFFERENTLY

We work with specialists we actually know.

Countertop fabrication and installation require dedicated expertise and specialized equipment. We don’t pretend otherwise. We work with a trusted countertop partner we’ve collaborated with for over two years — craftsmen we’ve vetted, worked alongside, and would recommend to our own families.
What that means for you: you get a specialist doing specialist work, coordinated and managed by a team that takes full responsibility for the outcome.


We manage the whole project — not just our part of it.

One of the biggest frustrations homeowners have with remodels is the finger-pointing. The contractor blames the fabricator. The fabricator blames the measurements. Nobody takes ownership.
That’s not how we operate. When you hire 3 Day Cabinet Pros, we will coordinate every trade involved in your project. If something isn’t right, it’s our responsibility to make it right — regardless of who did what.


Measurement is treated like the critical step it is.

Before your countertop is fabricated, we ensure templating is done with precision. The right measurements taken once are infinitely better than the wrong measurements corrected twice.


Quality shouldn't take forever.

A countertop installation that drags on is a planning failure. We schedule fabrication and installation in the right sequence, so your countertops arrive when your project is ready for them — not a week early sitting in a garage, and not a week late holding everything else up.

YOUR OPTIONS

Every kitchen and bathroom is different. Every homeowner has different priorities. We’ll help you find the material that fits your lifestyle, your aesthetic, and your budget.

Quartz

Engineered for consistency and durability. Non-porous, low maintenance, and available in a wide range of colors and patterns. An excellent choice for busy kitchens.

Granite

Natural stone with unique character in every slab. No two granite countertops are identical. Durable, heat-resistant, and timeless.

Laminate

Modern laminate has come a long way. Today’s options offer the look of stone or wood at a fraction of the cost — and are more durable than most people expect.

Not sure which material is right for your project? That’s exactly what the consultation is for.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation

Four steps. Precise results.

01
We Start with Your Vision

We’ll talk through your kitchen or bathroom, your design preferences, and your budget. We’ll show you material options and help you understand the real differences — not just the aesthetic ones, but the practical ones too.

02
We Build Your Plan and Your Estimate

You’ll receive a detailed, itemized estimate before anything is ordered or scheduled. You’ll know exactly what material you’re getting, what edge profile, what finish — and what it costs. No vague numbers. No surprises at installation.

03
Precision Fabrication and Installation

Templating is done carefully. Fabrication is handled by our trusted specialist partner. Installation is coordinated to fit seamlessly into your overall project timeline. We manage every handoff so nothing falls through the cracks.

04
We Walk Through It Together

Every seam. Every edge. Every cutout for your sink and fixtures. We review it all with you before we consider the job done. If anything isn’t exactly right, we handle it — no debate, no deflection.

What You Get

A countertop that fits perfectly — measured right, fabricated right, installed right

Material options across every price point without pressure toward the most expensive


	

Full project coordination so you’re never caught between contractors pointing fingers


	

A finished surface that anchors your kitchen or bathroom and holds up to daily life

THE RESULT

A countertop that looks exactly like what you chose, fits exactly like it should, and lasts exactly as long as it’s supposed to.

Not Every Kitchen Needs a Full Remodel. But Some Do. 
Here’s How to Know the Difference.

One of the most common questions we get from homeowners is simple: should I reface my cabinets or replace them entirely?
It’s a great question — and the honest answer can save you tens of thousands of dollars.

Or it can save you from making a decision you’ll regret in two years. We’d rather give you the truth upfront than sell you the wrong solution.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
See Our Cabinet Collections
Here’s A Quick, 2-Minute Explanation
Two Excellent Options. Two Different Problems.

Cabinet refacing and full cabinet replacement are both excellent options. They just solve different problems.

Refacing makes sense when your kitchen layout works and your cabinet boxes are in good shape — you just want a dramatically different look. Replacement makes sense when the bones of your kitchen need to change — the layout, the storage, the structure itself.

The mistake most homeowners make is assuming they need the more expensive option. The mistake some contractors make is letting them.

Use the guide below to get an honest read on where you stand.

The Side-by-Side Guide

	
Option A
Reface Your Cabinets If...

	
Your cabinet boxes are solid

Open your cabinet doors and look at the frames built into your walls. If the wood is firm, there’s no water damage, warping, or soft spots — your boxes have years of life left in them. Refacing makes perfect sense.


	
You're happy with your kitchen layout

Do your cabinets give you enough storage? Does the flow of your kitchen work for how you actually cook and live? If the answer is yes — and you just want it to look completely different — refacing delivers that transformation for a fraction of the cost.


	
You want results without the disruption

A full cabinet replacement means demolition, debris, and a kitchen that’s out of commission for weeks. Refacing means new doors, new drawer fronts, new hardware, and new veneers — installed efficiently, with far less mess and far less downtime.


	
You want to maximize your budget

Quality refacing typically costs 40 to 60 percent less than full cabinet replacement. If your goal is to make a kitchen that looks brand new without a brand new price tag, refacing is one of the smartest investments you can make in your home.


	
You're preparing to sell

Buyers notice kitchens. Updated cabinets dramatically improve first impressions and perceived value. If your boxes are sound, refacing gives you maximum visual impact for minimum investment — exactly what you want before listing.


	
Option B
Replace Your Cabinets If...

	
Your cabinet boxes are damaged

Water damage, warping, soft wood, or structural deterioration means the boxes themselves need to go. Refacing damaged boxes is like putting new siding on a house with a failing foundation. It won’t hold up — and it’s not something we’d recommend.


	
Your kitchen layout isn't working

If you need more storage, different cabinet placement, an island where there wasn’t one, or a fundamentally different flow — refacing can’t solve that. You need new cabinets in new positions. That’s a replacement conversation.


	
You're doing a full kitchen renovation anyway

If you’re already replacing countertops, moving plumbing, updating appliances, and reconfiguring the space — it often makes sense to replace cabinets as part of that larger project rather than reface and remodel around them.


	
Your cabinets are very old with outdated construction

Some older cabinet boxes simply weren’t built to modern standards. If the construction is poor, the materials are failing, or the interior functionality is beyond saving — starting fresh is the smarter long-term investment.


	
You want a completely different layout or size

Refacing works with what’s there. If you want taller cabinets, deeper cabinets, or cabinets in entirely different locations — replacement is the path forward.

Still Not Sure?

That’s completely normal. Most homeowners aren’t — and that’s exactly what the consultation is for.

We’ll look at your cabinets honestly, tell you what we see, and give you a straight answer about which direction makes more sense for your situation and your budget. No pressure toward the more expensive option. No upselling.

Just an honest assessment from someone who does this every day.

(And if refacing is the right answer, we’ll tell you that — even though a full remodel costs more.)

About Us

Our passion is to help you live better in your home. You have a vision for your home, and our team will help guide you into making that vision a reality. 

Forward Design Build Remodel is an award winning design build firm located in Ann Arbor, Michigan. We specialize in residential remodeling and custom homes. Our process is thoughtfully planned out with your happiness as the priority. You’ll be able to look back on your time creating your new space and say that you enjoyed your remodeling experience, not just the final result. 

Over 27 years ago Jef Forward, President & Creative Director at Forward, started this company with a passion for both architecture and building. He decided that the design-build method was exactly the service he wanted to provide for homeowners like you.

Team members Miranda, Andrew and Catherine meeting with our client for a pre-mechanical meeting.

Jef Forward, President & Creative Director and Jeff, Lead Carpenter, meeting on site.

A successful project is a beautiful, functional home completed within stated expectation of cost, service, and schedule from the beginning of design to the end of construction. Design build services feature us as your designer and your builder, an all-inclusive one-stop shop experience. All of the projects on our website are products of this.

Team members Ashley, chad and cam meeting during a final completion meeting with our clients for their new home addition! 

MEET THE FORWARD DESIGN BUILD TEAM
Community Support

Forward Design Build Remodel takes pride in not only our projects, but also in our community. In addition to nationwide causes, we are advocates for many local organizations in Southeastern Michigan -and the list is growing. Please click to learn more about our projects within the community!

LEARN MORE
Professional Affiliations

One key value at Forward is continuous growth - personal and professional. We belong to organizations, clubs and certification programs that ensure our designers and builders remain at the top of their game.

Meet The Team
Our Remodeling Contractors And Architectural Design Specialists Are Known Throughout The Ann Arbor Area As Experts In Remodeling Projects Of All Sizes.

 

We have built our in-house team of designers and craftspeople to take a project from inception to completion; their experience and out-of-the-box thinking ensure that your project is completed in style, on time, and on budget. Additionally, our trade partners and suppliers are specialists in their field and meet our high standards of practice. 
Let's Talk! 734.761.8403
The Consulting Team

Catherine Fillmore
Project Consultant

Catherine brings to the Forward team years of experience in project coordination. She is passionate about home renovation and helps our homeowners actualize their ideal home. When not at her dream job, she makes pottery as a member of the Ann Arbor Potters Guild and spends time with her family and Border Collie, Figgy.

Chad Weiler
Project  Consultant

Chad's remodeling story began at a very early age. At 12 years old, he drew conceptual plans for an extensive kitchen remodel for his family home and worked in his fathers wood shop, among other creative pursuits. His path would lead him to an architecture degree from Lawrence Technical University. Shortly after graduation, he married his wife Abby. Chad joined the Forward team in 2014, and is passionate about helping homeowners turn their dreams for their home into reality. Chad and Abby welcomed their first daughter, June Marie, in 2019, and their second daughter, Sylvia Mae, in 2021. In Chad's free time he enjoys spending time with his family, and playing hockey and golf.

Sam Wensman
Project  Consultant

A University of Michigan graduate and former coach, Sam brings a passion for creativity, collaboration, and helping others reach their goals. He loves connecting with homeowners and guiding them toward spaces that truly enhance and support their lives. Outside of work, Sam enjoys busy weekends filled with family and friends, hands-on projects around the house/garden, and chasing his two kids around with his lovely wife.

Kami Michels
Project  Consultant/ Designer

Kami is an Interior Designer with over 15 years of experience. She has a background in fine arts, earning her BFA in sculpture from the University of Michigan and continuing her interior design studies at Eastern Michigan University. She brings a creative, client-centered approach to her work, focusing on spaces that balance functionality with personality. She especially enjoys getting to know how clients live and translating that into designs that feel both intentional and exciting. For Kami, the best projects are the ones where clients truly fall in love with their homes again. Outside of work, she’s a busy mom of two and has a love for vintage furniture and all things a little unconventional.

The Design Team

Jef Forward
President & Creative Director

Jef brings a passion for the design and construction industry, and above all, helping our clients love their homes in the process! In his spare time, Jef enjoys spending time with the family, reading and tinkering with objects and technology.

Monica Hough-Forward
Operations Manager

Monica brings a direct no-nonsense approach to her work, yet always makes it fun! She attended EMU in 1992 and received her builders license in 2015. When she gets home from work, she loves spending time with her family or going on a long run.

Miranda Frye
Design Manager / Cabinet Specialist

Miranda is a pro when it comes to providing our clients with creative designs and project guidance throughout the process. She graduated from the Art Institute of Colorado in Interior Design and has years of experience in home renovation. She enjoys hiking, snowboarding, and spending time with her family in her free time.

Carly Withers
Senior Project Designer

Carly has an architecture degree from the University of Michigan, a masters degree in interior design from Pratt Institute, and has years of experience in residential design. Carly brings enthusiasm and passion for design to every step of the process - from functional space planning to sourcing cabinet hardware, to finding the perfect counter stool. After work she lovingly returns to the toddler & infant battlefield, but, when she has free time, Carly likes to read, swim, puzzle, and have game nights with friends. 

Ashley Carsten
Senior Project Designer

With over ten years of experience at Forward Design Build Remodel, Ashley is a skilled and passionate Architectural Designer known for her ability to blend creativity with functionality. A proud graduate of the University of Michigan with a Bachelor's degree in Architecture, she has honed her expertise in designing innovative and thoughtful spaces that meet the unique needs of her clients. Ashley enjoys the entire design process, from conceptualizing initial ideas to collaborating with clients on selecting materials and finishes that bring the vision to life. Outside of work, she dedicates all her time to her one-year-old son, cherishing every moment with her growing family.

Ashley Sattelberg
Project Designer

Ashley graduated from Central Michigan University in 2020 with a Bachelor's degree in interior design. She combines analytical skills and artistic talents to create functional and aesthetically pleasing homes. She has a keen eye for detail and ability to integrate individual elements into a cohesive whole. Her work reflects her commitment to exceeding client expectations and to fostering long term relationships. In her free time Ashley likes to spend time outdoors with family whether it’s golfing, camping, boating or snowmobiling.

Heather Trickett
Project Designer

Heather brings years of design experience and a talent for creating spaces that are both functional and beautiful. She loves the creative process, from solving design challenges to seeing ideas come to life, and especially enjoys helping clients create homes they love. Outside of work, Heather enjoys traveling, cooking, and spending time with friends, family, and her dog, Lady.

Marino Ard
Project Designer

Marino has an academic background in architecture and the natural sciences. His work is shaped by curiosity, travel, and a hands-on approach to design. Outside of work, he enjoys outdoor activities, cooking, and spending time with family.

Jayme Salutes
Cabinet Specialist/ Design Support

Jayme has a passion for creating spaces that balance beauty and function. She graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Interior Design from Eastern Michigan University, and especially appreciates timeless, thoughtful design and has a love for mid-century modern style. In her free time, she enjoys crocheting and reading.

Mahlah Armstead
Interior Designer

Mahlah has always had a passion for art and architecture, which allowed her to pursue a career in design as a perfect balance of the two. She graduated from Michigan State University in 2022 with a bachelor’s degree in Interior Design. Some hobbies she enjoys are painting and fitness, where she enjoys exercising outdoors in nature. In her free time you can find her spending time with friends, family and her baby boy.

Maya Mathew
Design Support

Maya gained her Bachelor's and Master's Degree in Architecture from Heidelberg, Germany. She worked as a licensed architect for 5 years in Germany, focusing on remodels, new custom homes, as well as commercial architecture. Maya moved to the United States in 2019 and joined the Forward Team in 2022. Outside of work she enjoys traveling, photography, cozy game nights + quality time with her family.

Sarah Hamze
Design Support

Sarah earned her Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design from Eastern Michigan University and brings a thoughtful, intentional perspective to her work. She is drawn to authentic, sustainable design and creating spaces that feel personal and grounded. Outside of work, Sarah enjoys traveling, practicing yoga, and spending time in nature.

The Build Team

Andrew Satchwell
Production Manager

Andrew started working in the construction industry at 14 for a family owned masonry company. Later, his career led him to be a House Leader at Habitat for Humanity. Andrew has worn many hats at Forward including Carpenter, Lead Carpenter, and Project Manager. Outside of work he loves watching sports and spending time with family.

Ryan Beaber
Estimator

Ryan graduated from Penn State in Architecture in 2014 and started working here a year later in April as a carpenter. He enjoys building houses more than designing them! While he’s not building houses, he enjoys running and doing yoga.

Brian Konicek
Purchasing/ Receiving

Brian’s professional background is primarily in managing teams and supply chain in the Grocery/Produce industry. He is excited for the career shift, and is happy to be a part of our great team at Forward. In his free time Brian enjoys writing and recording music from his home studio, playing pick up basketball, exploring Ann Arbor neighborhoods on walks with his wife and trying to brew the perfect cup of black coffee.

Tim Frincke
Project Manager

Tim grew up in Ann Arbor and studied at Washtenaw Community College. He has more than 15 years of experience in residential finish carpentry, remodeling, and building work. He had his own business for 6 years before he came to Forward in the fall of 2013. He enjoys woodworking, playing sports, and spending time with his wife and two children - Ella and Axel.

Ben Ranta
Project Manager

Ben's love of carpentry goes all the way back to when he was 10 and built a two story tree fort from old lumber and nails that his grandpa gave him. In addition to being a licensed builder, Ben is also Passive House Builder Certified through Phius. When not on the job site, Ben loves spending time at his cabin in the Upper Peninsula with his family.

Brian Schmidt
Project Manager

Brian is an artist and a carpenter.  He's probably best known for his concrete countertops and unique furniture pieces in wood, concrete, and metal. Brian brings many years of experience and an artist's touch to the Forward Design Build team!

Brent Shelton
Project Manager

Brent has been building since his Lincoln Log days and brings over 20 years of carpentry and construction coordination experience to the team. Known for his precision, clear communication, and collaborative spirit, he takes pride in getting every detail right. Outside of work, Brent enjoys time with his wife Becky, their miniature schnauzer Hank, and their community of friends—often around a campfire or game table.

John Hoder
Project Manager

John is a carpenter with a background in art and music. By nature he is very detail-oriented and always looking for new solutions to problems. John takes a great deal of satisfaction in collaborating with creative people to realize a common vision. In his free time John records and produces music, plays tennis and spends as much time as possible outdoors.

Jimmy Huffman
Warranty Manager

Jimmy joined the Forward team in 2023 with over 20 years experience in residential construction. He received his builders license in 2020 and is currently working towards a Masters of Science degree in Construction Management from Eastern Michigan University. Before working in residential construction, Jimmy served in the Michigan Army National Guard for 9 years as a Military Police Officer. 

Mike Shinney
Project Supervisor

Mike has been in the trades since 2017. He started in the mill as a shop hand in Arizona after a number of years working in kitchens, serving and bartending. Eventually he made his way to Denver, Colorado where he worked for a framing company and a custom wood/metal work shop. Finally returning back to Michigan in the fall of 2019, where he has been working solely in residential remodels. Outside of work Mike enjoys camping, backpacking and rock climbing with his wife and two dogs!

Mikey McGuffin
Rekindle Lead Carpenter

Starting as a rough framer at 18, Mikey built a diverse career in construction, including work as a union laborer on road projects and natural gas pipelines, and as an experienced tile setter. Now growing his skills at Forward, he brings hands-on expertise and a passion for quality. Outside of work, he enjoys riding Harley-Davidsons and spending time with his wife and their two children, Mikey and Wren

Jeff Bishop
Lead Carpenter

Jeff joined the Forward team in the fall of 2016. He has more than 20 years of experience with remodeling and tile work. He enjoys spending his free time in the outdoors.

Wally Schmid
Lead Carpenter

Wally joined the Forward team in the summer of 2021! He is a local 687 journeyman with 24 years experience in residential and commercial carpentry. He enjoys music, fishing, and spending time with family.

Jon Frincke
Lead Carpenter

Jon has been with Forward for many years and continuously grows his skills as a craftsmen. In his free time he enjoys gardening and cooking with ingredients from the garden. He does woodworking in his shop whenever he gets the chance. He also enjoys maple syrup making in his backyard and deep woods camping with his partner Lesley.

Jared Hill
Lead Carpenter

Jared joined the Forward team in 2022 with 9 years of remodeling experience. He has worked in almost all aspects of remodeling in his professional career. Jared loves working with his hands, a love that started in college while studying sculpture. He enjoys looking up new tools and watching videos to further enhance his construction knowledge. Jared and his fiancée Erika renovated their first home together and our now fixing up their second home. Outside of work he enjoys being outdoors, and spending time with Erika and their 3 dogs.

Jonah Stanevich
Lead Carpenter

Jonah graduated from Community high school in June of 2020. He was in the Ann Arbor Student Building Industry program for two years, where he learned the basics of near everything that goes into making a house, with emphasis on framing.He has an interest in almost anything having to do with physical creation from machining and woodworking, to drawing and carving. He has a special interest in leather working. One day Jonah hopes to have the time, means, and space to master at least a few of these hobbies.

Justin Stackling
Lead Painter

Justin brings years of diverse painting experience to the Forward team, with projects ranging from homes and commercial buildings to automotive work. Known for his calm, focused approach, precision, and work ethic, he takes pride in delivering high-quality results with careful attention to detail. Outside of work, Justin enjoys hunting, fishing, golfing, camping, and spending time outdoors with his family.

Colton Arnett
Carpenter/ Painter

Colton’s experience in the field started at 14 years old, where he worked with his father who owned a painting company. For the first ten years of his career, Colton worked three jobs that included painting, roofing and installing hardwood floors. He then earned his Class B Commercial Drivers License, and drove professionally for a few years. For the past 3 years, Colton worked exclusively on kitchens and bathrooms prior to joining our team at Forward. Outside of work, Colton enjoys spending time with his two sons. He also enjoys going to the gym and playing basketball every Sunday in a men's league.

Cameron Burris
Carpenter

Cameron was in the Ann Arbor Student Building Industry program in high school, where he participated in Skills USA carpentry competitions. He found his love for carpentry while building stages for the high school theatre, and was also an actor on the stages he built! Outside of work, Cam likes to play music and hangout with friends.

Dirk Johnson
Project Manager

Dirk grew up in rural Minnesota, where he developed a lifelong passion for building and problem-solving. After a 15-year career leading IT for a nationwide general contractor, he moved to Michigan in 2016, earned his Residential Builder’s License, and started his own construction company specializing in home renovations. In his free time, he enjoys traveling, hiking, museums, reading, and technology.

Drew Johnson
Carpenter

Drew is a skilled construction specialist with six years of hands-on experience in remodeling and historic restoration. After high school, he spent five years with the same contractor, building custom decks and completing interior renovations. He later worked as a carpenter in downtown Detroit, helping restore a historic building into modern apartments. Drew enjoys collaborating with clients and tradespeople to create beautiful, functional spaces. Outside of work, he loves to be outdoors and enjoys time with his fiancée and daughter.

Makayla Collins
Apprentice

Makayla joined Forward Design Build Remodel in the summer of 2023. Prior to working at Forward, Makayla attended the Michigan Career and Technical Institute Trade School for construction. Outside of work, Makayla enjoys painting and winter activities.

The Service Team

Lynnette Brice
Business Manager

Lynnette handles our books and client statements. When she’s not at work or watching hockey, she enjoys gardening or traveling - though she doesn’t get to go as often as she’d like.

Amanda Lesser
Content Creator/ Photographer

Amanda is a photographer and content creator dedicated to telling the story of Forward Design Build through thoughtful, authentic visuals. From the earliest stages of a project to the finished result, she documents the hard work, craftsmanship, and care that go into every build. Her goal is to showcase each project in a way that feels genuine, polished, and compelling. Outside of work, Amanda loves traveling, discovering new cafés, and spending time outdoors.

Andi Harvey
Brand Strategy & Marketing Manager

With a foundation in fine arts and over 20 years of experience in graphic and UX/UI design, Andi brings depth and authenticity to brand strategy and visual storytelling. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her husband, son, and two doodle-mixed dogs.

Susie Cutting
Office Manager

Susie joined the Forward team at the beginning of 2017. Before she became a full-time stay-at-home mom to raise her son, she worked as an office manager for MLive.com. Now that her son is older, she's excited to be part of a team again. While not at work, she loves being with her son and spending time with friends and family.

James Rowe
Bookkeeper

James graduated from Washtenaw Community College in 2015 with an Associates Degree in Applied Science Accounting. Outside of work he enjoys most outdoor activities, especially camping and hiking (preferably out west, such as Colorado or Wyoming). James also enjoys spending time on woodworking projects.

Client Testimonials
Our mission is deliver excellent service to our Ann Arbor area design build clients, building relationships that go beyond the duration of their design project. Here are a few generous words we've received about projects we were a part of.
Nature Home Retreat, Custom Home Design and Build | Ann Arbor, MI

The Meadows fell in love with the natural surroundings of their location and wanted to maximize views - while creating a modern open concept home for entertaining. They enjoyed each stage of our design-build process, and we enjoyed working with them to create their beautiful nature home retreat! 

“There is not a night that we don’t take our dog for a walk, and as we’re coming up to the home, and we don’t do it out of tradition, it’s truly out of just a feeling of, wow, we say, can you believe we live here?”
- Randy & Linda
Modern Open Concept Home Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

The Bells loved their home, but were tired of the inefficient first floor. The goal was to create an open concept floor plan that improved the flow, and made entertaining easier. They wanted to enlarge a small kitchen and open the space into the living area, and create a modern and fun space.

Our team delivered with this modern open concept design, that allows the Bells to spend more quality time together as a family and has become the go-to home for gatherings!

“Working with the designer was incredible because they just streamlined the process in such a way that it made it so simple to pick out materials. They automatically had such a good sense of what we wanted and really matched what our vision was.”
- Chris & Andrea
Classic Kitchen Redesign, Kitchen Remodel | Plymouth, MI

Chris and Danielle came to us wanting an updated kitchen that would better function for their daily life with two young children. We planned on a full kitchen remodel for this project. 

Our goal was to increase the working triangle and amount of work surfaces, lighten the space with more lighting and brighter finishes, and expand the circulation between rooms.

"I honestly don't see how you could go wrong with hiring Forward. I truly don't believe that any other run of the mill construction company we would have gone with would have provided us with the level of service and attention to detail, and just their general attitude quite frankly the same that Forward did." 
- Danielle & Chris
Creating Cohesion, First Floor and Bathroom Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

Kim and her husband wanted an open concept first floor living area, and then later worked with us again for transforming two upstairs bathrooms. This video shows Kim's remodeling journey, and living in a home remodeled by us!

"I think it was one of the best decisions we ever made." 
- Kim
Clean & Contemporary, Interior Remodel | Dexter, MI

In 2008, we worked with Dan and Marie for the first time to remodel the first floor of their home. Fast forward to 2020, and we were able to work with them again! Check out this video to learn more about why they chose to work with us again, and how this project turned out!

"We’ve been very pleased with the results. There’s always quality workmanship and they will follow up.” 
- Dan & Marie
The Tuscan Kitchen, Kitchen and Basement Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

We first worked with Doug and Nancy in 2004, when they decided they were ready to finish their basement. They wanted a place that they could host friends and family for events, and to spend more time together as a family. 

Fast forward to over 10 years later, and they were ready to update their kitchen as well. Hear more from Doug and Nancy in this video about their remodeling journey!

"Forward Designers & Builders exceeded our high expectations in all aspects of their service from creative conceptualization through superior construction. We had many ideas to incorporate in the design and no details were overlooked. The project moved in accordance with our agreed upon timeline with minimal disruption to our daily household activities. Every member of the team, including their partnering subcontractors, was a skilled professional and dedicated to the highest quality of work and created an enjoyable build experience." 
- Doug & Nancy
Cohesive Mid-Century Modern Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

"We never doubted that Forward had our project under control.”

“We had a great experience working with Forward Design Build for our extensive remodel. Our project was broad in scope and because of two prior additions and redos posed challenges. We never doubted that Forward had our project under control.” 
- John & Anne
Traditional Home Addition and Interior Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

"Our house is so much more livable now! I would highly recommend Forward for their quality design and workmanship, reliability, and management of sub-contractors.”

“My husband and I are absolutely delighted by the work that Forward Design and has done for us! We have lived in our 1924 bungalow for more than 40 years now, and last year decided to address the laundry list of problems that annoyed us during that time. We had a leaky basement with crumbling floor, a garage rotted beyond repair, a gravel driveway that would be much nicer if paved, icy back porch stairs in the winter, knob and tube wiring, and no first-floor bathroom! We contacted Forward to help us address these issues with an integrated design, and to manage the legions of sub-contractors.

The finished product is fantastic. With a small addition we now have a fine first-floor bath, new kitchen, mudroom with breezeway to the new garage. Our basement is dry with a smooth floor. These changes are nicely integrated and retain the character of the house. The Forward team really opened our eyes to design possibilities that we had not considered. They were spot-on with advice and recommendations. The design process was interesting, and the team very accommodating and easy to work with, particularly when making hardware selections.

Our building phase was not without a few bumps in the road – one large one being the Covid-19 shutdown of several months. Still we were very confident that Forward would provide us a quality build and address any issues. Our site manager, Rob W., did an outstanding job of moving progress ahead, working magic with scheduling sub-contractors, and keeping us informed. The sub-contractors all did superior work. (The excavator was particularly impressive). The Forward carpenters saw to all the rest. I was pleased that all the workers on site, were pleasant to be around as well as respectful of our home.”

To summarize: Forward Design and Build company did an outstanding job for us, meeting all our requirements. Their work meets high standards, is attentive to details, and Forward is very responsive when issues arise. The actual cost was quite close to the contracted amount. Our house is so much more livable now! I would highly recommend Forward for their quality design and workmanship, reliability, and management of sub-contractors. I felt very comfortable working with them - they made it easy for us to undertake this project.”
- Jill
Textured Craftsman Custom Home | Dexter, MI

"we decided to choose Forward to build our custom home based on the quality of their previous work and their professionalism, and we are very glad that we chose them!”

“Our experience with Forward Design Build was excellent from start to finish. After meeting with several design build firms and construction companies, we decided to choose Forward to build our custom home based on the quality of their previous work and their professionalism, and we are very glad that we chose them! During the design phase, they listened to our needs and wants, worked with us to create a functional yet stylish home, took into account and worked with us on our budget, and ultimately were able to design a home that met all our expectations. Forward then exceeded expectations during the building phase of our project. Their construction manager kept us abreast of all work that was going on at the site and made sure that the work done by the subs was top quality. In addition, the project was done essentially on time (less than ten days past the initial finish date during an 11 months build) and on budget (literally less than a tenth of one percent off our initial budget).

The quality of the finished home is excellent, and we would strongly encourage anyone looking for a custom home builder in the Ann Arbor area consider Jef and his crew.” 
- Alex & Sara
Major Bathroom Remodel | Ann Arbor, MI

"I am very picky and the quality of the work is excellent"

"We used Forward Design Build for both a minor kitchen remodel, and a major bathroom remodel in a 1930's house. Jef and his team did a fantastic job and the results are wonderful.

What I like best about working with Jef is his attention to detail. I am very picky and the quality of the work is excellent. If there is anything I don't like, they take care of it until I am satisfied. 

We had our bathroom and two closets completely torn out, all the plaster, tile and flooring, then rebuilt into a larger master bath. The jobsite was left clean each day, and they sealed the rooms to keep dust out of the rest of the house. We are extremely pleased with the results, and will use Forward again on our next project."  

- David & Charlotte
Fresh Home Redesign | Ann Arbor, MI

"As first time remodelers, we appreciated how thorough the Forward team was in describing the entire process so that we had no surprises from start to finish.”

"We had an excellent experience with Forward Design Build Remodel. Our project included finishing the basement, full kitchen remodel, new mudroom, powder room remodel, and wood floors throughout the first floor and staircase. As first time remodelers, we appreciated how thorough the Forward team was in describing the entire process so that we had no surprises from start to finish. It was a pleasure working with Ashley leading the design team and Rob leading the construction team.

Ashley and the design team listened carefully to our wants and needs to come up with creative solutions that worked for us. She would quickly CAD up 3D designs and even render in patterns and fabrics to give us an idea of how things would look. She kept the process going at a good pace for us to stay on schedule.

Due to the scope of our project, we moved out during the renovations, but Rob kept us well informed about the status during our weekly meetings at the house. He regularly updated and sent out a calendar to track the progress and give us a look ahead. Despite our not being there day to day, the construction team kept the house as tidy as could be expected - and did an excellent job sealing off the rest of the house from dust and debris. We had a hard deadline for the project completion and the Forward team kept right on schedule.

The quality of work and the materials used are well worth the investment. We love our new home and would not hesitate to hire Forward again in the future.

- Ellen & Michael
Lake Front Cottage, Custom Home Design and Build | Pinckney, MI

"We especially appreciated his willingness to listen to our ideas and desires"

"Our experience with Jef Forward and Forward Design Build was very positive. Jef designed and built a lake home for us. We especially appreciated his willingness to listen to our ideas and desires and then produce a home that incorporated those in a very liveable and beautiful way.

Our home is "us" and we have the designer touches that make it special. The workmanship and timeliness of the project were great. We are happy to recommend Jef and Forward Design Build."
- Laurie & Fred

Why Design Build?
Learn The Advantages Of Design-Build Over Separate Architectural And Construction Firms
Design Build is Faster, More Efficient and Cost Effective

The design build process has several benefits versus hiring a separate design or architectural firm and construction firm for your project. Forward’s design build services provide a one-stop solution for homeowners looking to remodel, add an addition, or build a new home. We are experts who can accomplish all phases of your project faster and more efficiently. Our professional design and construction experts work together under one roof, creating a seamless process that saves you time and money, and enhances your involvement for a greater sense of pride in your home. With one company managing the entire process from start to finish, the overall remodeling experience runs more smoothly, gets done faster and saves you money.

The Results of Our Design Build Process
Better Cost Control

Our designers are acutely aware of building costs since they are directly involved with the construction of all their remodeling projects.

Our design build process allows our estimator to develop the estimate as the design progresses. This allows scope decisions to be made based on tangible information.

Faster Transition From Design to Construction

Once plans are complete, we are ready to build.

Alternatively, when you hire an independent designer or architect, this stage can take quite a while as: contractors are interviewed, bids and subcontractor bids are secured, estimates roll in, and plans are modified or even re-designed to fit the budget.

The advantage of in-house design is that we transition your project smoothly from design to construction without a hitch.

Better Design and Communication

With the designer and builder sharing an office, they are in constant communication from the very beginning. Design ideas are quickly vetted and expanded on with our team input.

The production manager is closely involved with design creation to ensure the design is “build-able”.

The designer is closely involved with your project with our 5 Key Meetings approach to ensure all design details are properly executed.

Greater Accountability

If design and construction are managed by separate companies, finger pointing can occur when things go wrong. This often results in the homeowner picking up the tab for increased construction costs due to errors or omissions made by the designer, architect, or contractor.

Since both the design and construction of your project are handled by one company, there is greater accountability for all aspects of the project.

The buck stops with us! As the designer and the builder of the project, the responsibility to fix any goofs lies with us, eliminating finger-pointing.

Remove and Replace Projects Designed For Clients Throughout Greater Ann Arbor, MI

Is the layout of your home working for you, but you’re ready to update the finishes? Rekindle is our solution for your remove and replace interior renovation projects. 

You’ll receive the same top notch service with a clear-cut process tailored to what you’re looking for. For over 25 years, Forward has been helping clients love their home again.

The Rekindle Process

We’ll review your list of priorities, goals and dreams for your home. We will also perform research on your existing home and required building and zoning codes.

We’ll choose your fixtures and materials and develop interior renderings that show the finished vision coming to life. The result of this step is a clear vision of your project, with a simple scope of work and budget.

As construction on your home begins, we’ll work efficiently, meeting with you on a regular basis and completing your project on-time and on-budget to give you peace of mind.

You want a completely new look for your kitchen, bathroom, interior space or first floor.

Interior Furnishing Services I Greater Ann Arbor, MI

Our full-service furnishing services are a resource we offer to our current and past remodeling clients. Our designers coordinate, recommend, and facilitate the placement and purchase of interior and exterior furnishings.

Our Services

In-home Decor Consultations

Space Planning

Art & Accessories Selections

Order & Installation Management

Styling & Staging

Our Process

Our design planning consists of six separate phases that will take you through the process of furnishing your new space(s).  The six phases are defined as follows:

In-Home Consultation  - Your designer will meet with you in your home. Together you will discuss your desired aesthetic, measure the space(s) and talk about existing pieces you wish to incorporate. You will also discuss your desired budget.

Space Planning - Your designer will create 2D line drawings of your space with a variety of layout options. You may choose one design, or combine several ideas to create your final layout.	

Selections and Presentation - We will help you to create a Pinterest board that you will share with your designer, helping direct their selection process.  Your designer will make selections and present ideas to you, often using sample materials such as fabrics and rugs.

Estimating - Once a design direction has been determined, your final estimate will be prepared. When all numbers have been compiled, it will be presented for your approval.

Ordering, Receiving and Delivery  -  All items will be ordered and received by Blue Birch or our receiving partner.  Each item will be inspected for damage and stored safely until install day.  

Installation - Once all items are received, installation will occur.  This is an exciting day - you will see it all come together!    

For MORE INFORMATION: Visit our Home Page to learn about our complete list of services.

Author: Jef Forward

The cost for working with an interior designer for your furnishings varies. Factors that impact the cost are how many rooms you’re doing, the cost range of the furnishing pieces chosen, and how in-depth you’re going within the rooms. 

When we say in depth, we mean are you only doing the furniture in the space? Or are you working with your designer all the way down to accessories that will be set out?

The Forward Experience
Our 3-Step Process For Remodeling & Custom Homes

Our design philosophy is simple: solve our clients' functional needs with creative solutions that inspire and represent their personality. We do this by asking questions, listening, suggesting, challenging, and learning about our clients. Great designs come from a talented team of design professionals who know how to listen. At Forward Design Build Remodel, your input and feedback are vital to making your home design dreams come true.

Our Design Build Process
Step 1: Clarify Your Vision
After a design agreement is signed, we begin by reviewing your list of priorities, goals and dreams for the project. This becomes a guide as we design your new space. We will also perform research on your existing home and required building and zoning codes.
We’ll then create floor plans of your existing home, and sketch three potential layout changes to the existing plans. These concept designs will show three different price points within your desired budget, showing you what’s possible for your home. We will also create a comprehensive project evaluation outlining your project parameters. This will give a very general idea of the scope, time commitment and the cost of your project.
Step 2: Shape the Design
This is where the design gets fine-tuned and the details and finishes start to emerge. The design evolves with a thorough review of all potential materials, colors and fixture selections. 
The design drawings grow into 3-dimensional representations of the scope of work. Interior renderings show the finished vision coming to life.
The scope of work and budget evolves to document these decisions, illustrate cost drivers and the decision history of the budget. The agreement documents are where it all comes together! Permit and construction drawings are completed.  All selections are finalized and documented. We'll schedule a trade day for our suppliers and trade partners to visit your home, review their work and provide us with final cost estimates.
At the end of this step, the work of our designers, estimator, production team and trade partners result in a plan that we all can follow and build with confidence.
Step 3: Confirm & Finalize
The build phase starts with a pre-construction meeting, where we detail our communication, dust control and project meeting protocols. 
During construction, you can expect consistent meetings with your Project Manager, respectful craftsmen who leave the work area clean, and regular quality inspections. Our goal is to make your project easy, with proactive updates and minimal interruptions to your life. On time and on budget!
Your project team includes your Project Manager, Project Designer and Project Coordinator who work together throughout your experience to make sure that we’re all on the same page. 
The construction of your project ends with a final inspection walk-through, to ensure the quality and completion of every detail. Then it’s time to enjoy living in your new space!
Enjoy Your Great Decisions 

Your warranty period starts once all construction is complete. We will provide you with a written industry-leading warranty that outlines all of our activities over the course of your warranty period.

We stand behind our work, and take pride in knowing that you are enjoying your home and the process that delivered your completed space.

Home Care & Repair Team

For each and every client we serve with a design-build project, we gain a holistic view of your home. This gives us a unique home team advantage when you need help with all the various small projects that come up in life! Our home care & repair team is here to help, continuing our goal towards clients for life. Small projects can be any type of project around the house, from a simple repair to removing and replacing finishes. These projects typically do not involve design, but if they do, we can help with them too!
